purpose: Verify that the project's code-only PunktSentenceTokenizer produces identical boundaries under nltk 3.9.1 and 3.10.0.

dataset.input_definition: Every frozen canonical source sentence plus every reference string.

interpretation: The dependency pin change does not alter the repository's sentence splitter on the governed Multi-News validation inputs. This does not imply that arbitrary NLTK APIs or downloaded Punkt models are equivalent across versions.
